note: Generated by write_white_null_table (steadiness_tests.rs), fixed seeds. White gap-free readings, detrended as a take is (longterm::detrend with DETREND_S): a quadratic under 20 min, by readings; else a running median, by its window (5 to 1,800 readings) and the take's length over it (4 to 8). 40000000 readings drawn a point (1000 to 40000 series). Each point: the mean correlation at lags 1 to 128 (or a third of the take), and the mean, variance and skew of Ljung-Box Q over 10 lags once that bias is off (#1199).
